corrections.reason: Ge'ez verbal noun ጻድቃ (to do righteous deeds, ኢያፈድፈደክሙ ጻድቃ = 'አብዝታችሁ ሥራ ካልሠራችሁ') has 6th-order ድ in the image, not 3rd-order ዲ, and does not wrap mid-word into አብዝታችሁ.

corrections.old_text: ሏል ። ዘፀ ፴፪ ፲፪ ፥ ዳዊትስ ም
corrections.corrected_text: ሏል ። ዘፀ ፴፪ ፴፪ ፥ ዳዊትስ ም
corrections.reason: The verse numeral in Exodus 32:32 (ዘፀ ፴፪ ፴፪) is clearly printed as ፴፪ (32), misread as ፲፪ (12).

corrections.old_text: ንተ ገብሩ እሉ አባግዕ እንዘ የ
corrections.corrected_text: ንተ ገብሩ እሉ አባግዕ እንዘ ያ
corrections.reason: Ge'ez imperfect verb ያላምሆሙ (from አልመሀ, 'while they graze') begins with 4th-order ያ at the end of line 32.
The printed glyph at the end of line 12 has the 2nd-order right-side stroke of ሩ (መምሩን).
Ge'ez imperative ኅሠር ('be disgraced/despised', translating Raca) is printed with 6th-order ኅ.
Ge'ez ለእኅሁ ('to his brother') is printed with 6th-order ኅ (or 2nd-order ኁ).
